# API to MCP Converter
 
Convert any API into a working MCP server in seconds.  
No code needed. Runs locally. Free.
 
## The problem
 
The MCP ecosystem is growing fast — but most APIs don't have an MCP server yet.  
Building one from scratch means writing boilerplate, parsing specs, handling auth, and manually editing config files.
 
We do all of that automatically.
 
## What it does
 
- Paste any OpenAPI URL or upload a spec file
- Get a fully working MCP server generated instantly
- Run `python setup.py` — one command, done
- Auto-detects Claude, Cursor, Cline, Zed and configures everything
- No JSON editing. No file hunting. No deployment needed
- Runs locally — your data never leaves your machine
